headline: ‘Center Stage’: A Star of Shanghai’s 1930s Heyday Is (Re)Born
context: This 1991 film is at once a biopic devoted to the Chinese silent-film star, Ruan Lingyu, and a self-reflexive documentary starring Maggie Cheung.
